entries.question: If n(A) = 4, find n[P(A)].
steps: The power set P(A) contains every subset of A.
By the power-set counting formula n[P(A)] = 2⁴ = 16.

entries.question: If n(A)=0, find n[P(A)].
steps: A has no elements, hence A = ∅.
The only subset of ∅ is ∅ itself, so P(A) = {∅}.

entries.question: If n[P(A)] = 256, find n(A).
steps: Let n(A) = k; then the power set has 2ᵏ members.
